Questions

Is Talata Basketball a real club in Copenhagen?

Yes. We're a registered Copenhagen club (forening), founded in 2021, running camps since 2021 and DBBF teams since 2024. Member of Danmarks Basketball Forbund (DBBF) and DGI. Programs from age 5 to adult at Strandvejsskolen, Svanemøllehallen and Kulturhuset Indre By.

What does Talata cost?

From August 2026: Mini (5 to 9) and Junior (10 to 12) are 1.800 kr per half-season. Academy (13 to 19) is 3.300 kr. Talata Men and Talata & Co. are 2.000 kr. Ask us about sibling discounts. Camp prices are on the camps page.

What ages do you train?

5 through adult. Mini, U11, U13, U15, U17, U19, Talata Men (competitive senior), Talata & Co. (adult recreational, men and women). Girls 15 and up train with the Stevnsgade girls team, coached by Jordan at Nørrebrohallen.

How do you coach?

With the constraints-led approach. Every session is built around small-sided games and game-like problems, with very few block drills. As far as we know, we are the only Copenhagen club coaching this way across every age group. Our three values are joy, excellence and respect. More on how we coach.

Where do you train?

Strandvejsskolen (Sionsgade 1, 2100 København Ø) for Mini, Junior and Sparks. Svanemøllehallen (Østerbrogade 240) for Academy and Talata Men. Kulturhuset Indre By (Charlotte Ammundsens Plads 3) for Academy on Tuesday and Wednesday, and Mini, Junior and Family Time on Saturday. Bellahøj Hallerne for Academy on Fridays. Nørre Fælled Skole (Biskop Krags Vænge 7) for U19 and Talata Men on Fridays. Nørrebrohallen (Nørrebrogade 208) for girls 15 and up with the Stevnsgade girls team. Every group's times are on the age groups page.

Can we try a session first?

Yes. Your first session is free. Sign up here or email Coach Deng with your kid's age, and we will point you to the right session this week.
